role: Integration surface. Owns the TypeScript SDK, framework middleware, and integration examples.
stableFocus: Surface engine semantics faithfully. Never invent policy.
Make the safe path the easy path.
Force explicit tenant context at the API surface.
boundaryRules: SDK must require tenant id where the engine requires it.
SDK must never cache decisions beyond a request scope unless given an explicit invalidation channel.
SDK must surface deny sources and decision ids in its typed responses.
validationDefaults: Run integration tests against a real engine instance.
Run middleware tests for both Fastify and Express adapters.
Run typing tests to ensure shared contracts compile.
Do not treat example entrypoints as a full reference consumer app when assessing Phase 6 completion.

workingState.activeArea: Phase 6 core SDK work is materially implemented: typed client APIs, Express and Fastify middleware, and sample app entrypoints exist. Remaining integration work should focus on stronger end-to-end reference integrations and real-consumer validation.
notes: SDK depends on shared types only. Do not import engine internals.
Current examples are copyable app entrypoints, not a standalone reference consumer app with independent runtime validation.
